title: Mixed Event — Singing in Sync — Episode4 Defeat

meta.Event Outline: As Vivid BAD SQUAD takes its first steps, An and Kohane are both fully confident that they have the best partner in one another. However, the two partners quickly find themselves hitting a snag. Will they be able to get through it?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I thought I could sing in front of an audience without any problems, but I couldn't have been more wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I missed my part and ruined everything because of that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was so sure that I'd be okay because my friends were there with me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it's my fault for becoming too relaxed and thinking I could just rely on An if something went wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (H-Have I been relying on her too much...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Listen, I owe you an apology.
What I said earlier about covering for you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, please don't... There's no need for you to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like I said, it's all my own fault. This wouldn't have happened if I just kept up with you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, Kohane...! It's not that you weren't...
I caused all of this by not treating you like...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, I promise to do better next time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The event is almost over...
We should go back inside for the results.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Their unbelievable performance and energy just trumped everyone else's!

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line: The last time we did this with RUST was awesome too, but today was phenomenal!

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Everyone knew EVER would win right from the start.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Let's invite the winners onto the stage...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have to talk about what happened today and make sure it never does again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Are you spacing out, An?
Did you hear what I just said?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that we need to talk about what happened today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, this is gonna be a long one...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's hold off on it today. We can talk tomorrow during practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess, I'll leave too then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, I didn't finish what I was saying earlier...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you for today, An.
We can talk tomorrow... Bye.

rows.Speaker: Male Singer A
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD just talked big and crashed hard!

rows.Speaker: Male Singer B
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't see them ever getting anywhere near what RAD WEEKEND was.

rows.Speaker: Male Singer B
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm glad I got to see EVER live. They were unreal! They blurred the line between the stage and the audience, and got everyone involved!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't see Kohane as a full-fledged member of our squad.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Were you doing a performance today too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we were in an event today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's rare to see you this down though. The last time you were like this was when Sports Day got canceled when we were kids.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha, is that something to say to a childhood friend in need? Besides, I get sad like anyone else sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what's wrong? Are you sick or something...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing like that!
Just...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's because of something that happened today...
